PROJECT ATLAS — EXECUTION PLAN
Programme window: 3 February 2026 through 30 October 2026
Owner: Programme Management Office
Status: Approved at the 28 January steering committee

GOAL
Ship Atlas to general availability by 30 October 2026 with SOC 2 Type II attestation in hand, zero unplanned customer downtime during migration, and 40 reference-able enterprise accounts live on the new platform.

SUCCESS MEASURES
- SOC 2 Type II report issued by the auditor no later than 2 October 2026.
- 100% of enterprise tenants migrated with under 5 minutes cumulative downtime each.
- 40 named accounts live and referenceable.
- Gross margin at or above 71% at GA.

CONSTRAINTS
- Engineering headcount is frozen until Q3.
- The auditor requires 90 days of continuous control evidence before fieldwork.
- No production changes during the 14-22 August customer conference.

RISKS
- The backfill has never been run at full production volume.
- The security vendor's remediation retest has a 3 week lead time.
- Two of the four reference accounts are still in procurement.
